description: Unique ID of one farm-season (plot) record
Household farm ID; the same farm appears in many seasons and in both train and test
Broad agro-ecological zone of the region
Local season name (e.g. Long rains / Short rains; Masika / Vuli; Season A / B; Meher / Belg)
Total land cultivated by the household
Size of the surveyed maize plot
1 = member of a farmer cooperative or group
Extension officer visits during the season
1 = received input credit or a loan this season
Distance to nearest input / output market
Topsoil pH (water); missing where no soil test was done
Days between rainfall onset and planting
Sole maize / Beans / Cowpea / Pigeonpea / Desmodium (push-pull)
1 = pesticide applied against fall armyworm or stalk borer
Total rainfall over the growing season (satellite-gauge blend)
Longest run of dry days during the season
Mean daily maximum temperature over the season
Peak-season NDVI over the plot; missing under persistent cloud
Fall armyworm damage: Absent / Low / Medium / High
